dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Up for a chat, by any chance?

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: Sure, but what should we talk about...?

dialogues.speaker: Candace
dialogues.text: If you don't mind, could you tell me about the places you've been to? Any of them will do.

choices.text: About the scenery and culture of Mondstadt...

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Verdant grass, a city of song and freedom...

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: I'd love to see it for myself.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: The desert has been my home my entire life. I hardly even journey to the other side of the Wall of Samiel.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: But after hearing you speak of all these faraway lands, I can't help but find the thought of traveling quite... enchanting.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Ah, it truly is a tempting offer... But I cannot forsake my duty to protect Aaru Village...

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: Perhaps your words will take root within my heart, and one day, my desire to see the world beyond will sprout and grow.

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: When that day comes, I shall follow your footsteps.

choices.text: About the scenery and culture of Liyue...

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: A nation of trade and contracts... I've heard about it before, but your description paints a whole new picture.

choices.text: About the scenery and culture of Inazuma...

response.speaker: Candace
response.text: A land surrounded by the ocean, a castle built atop an island...
